evidence.snippet: intracellular MTX polyglutamates inhibit AICAR transformylase (ATIC) activity and thereby promote adenosine release
evidence.explanation: Methotrexate (as polyglutamates) inhibits ATIC enzymatic activity.

paper.title: Fibroblasts from methotrexate-sensitive mice accumulate methotrexate polyglutamates but those from methotrexate-resistant mice do not.

evidence.snippet: intracellular MTX polyglutamates inhibit AICAR transformylase (ATIC) activity and thereby promote adenosine release
evidence.explanation: Inhibition of ATIC promotes release of adenosine; ATIC inhibition is the upstream driver of adenosine accumulation.

paper.title: Fibroblasts from methotrexate-sensitive mice accumulate methotrexate polyglutamates but those from methotrexate-resistant mice do not.

evidence.snippet: adenosine signaling via A2A AdoRs, adenylyl cyclase, and cAMP reduces TNFα-induced MMP-3 production by interfering with p38 MAPK/ATF-2 activity
evidence.explanation: Adenosine activates A2A adenosine receptor signaling in rheumatoid synoviocytes.

paper.title: Adenosine inhibits TNFα-induced MMP-3 production in MH7A rheumatoid arthritis synoviocytes via A2A receptor signaling.

evidence.explanation: A2A receptor activation reduces TNFα-induced MMP-3 production by rheumatoid synovial cells.

evidence.snippet: matrix metalloproteinase 3 (MMP-3) is released by fibroblast-like synoviocytes in response to inflammatory signaling
evidence.explanation: MMP-3 released by rheumatoid synoviocytes mediates the inflammatory tissue destruction of rheumatoid arthritis; reducing it is the therapeutic endpoint.

paper.title: Adenosine inhibits TNFα-induced MMP-3 production in MH7A rheumatoid arthritis synoviocytes via A2A receptor signaling.

evidence.snippet: Methotrexate administered weekly in low doses is a mainstay in the therapy of rheumatoid arthritis.
evidence.explanation: Low-dose methotrexate is a mainstay treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

paper.title: Low-dose methotrexate: a mainstay in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
